summary: Frontend-only retest completed for Firebase free-tier deploy readiness: Hosting + Firestore config validated, Storage usage removed from source, production build passes, and public homepage/admin-login route load verified.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows repeated Firestore permission warnings (siteSettings/ratings/analytics track) during homepage load, though UI still renders.

action_items: If public reads are intended for siteSettings/ratings, align Firestore rules to prevent runtime permission warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: firebase.json contains only hosting + firestore blocks (no storage block) and no storage.rules reference.
No Firebase Storage SDK import/usage found in source files under frontend/src.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build succeeded via `yarn build` and generated /app/frontend/build. Homepage and /adevglobpik load on public URL. Initial homepage check captured preloader state; second check after longer wait confirmed full render.
rca of the issue: Original deploy issue stemmed from including Firebase Storage in config/deploy scope on free tier. Current codebase now targets Hosting + Firestore only, which resolves deploy-scope mismatch. Remaining runtime console warnings are Firestore rule-permission related and separate from Storage/deploy config.
